definition: Air Travel Organisers’ Licensing is the United Kingdom’s licensing and consumer protection scheme for qualifying air travel arrangements.
entry_text: Air Travel Organisers’ Licensing is the United Kingdom’s licensing and consumer protection scheme for qualifying air travel arrangements.
example: A travel organizer checks whether a planned flight-inclusive package falls within the ATOL scheme.
label: Air Travel Organisers' Licensing

sources.note: The UK regulator describes licensing for applicable flight-inclusive and flight-only arrangements and consumer financial protection when the organizer stops trading. Qualifying is an important scope qualifier.
